sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Peoples Local Government Amendment Act 1972
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT V OF 1973
ACT V OF 1973
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE PEOPLE'S LOCAL GOVERNMENT
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1972
An Act to amend
the North-West Frontier Province People's Local
Government
Ordinance, 1972
[Gazette of N.-W.
F. P., Extra ordinary, 12th January 1973]
No. Legis. 1 (33)/72.-The
following Act of the Provincial Assembly of the North-West Frontier Province,
having been assented to by the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province, on
the 12th January 1973, !s hereby published for general information-
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the North-West Frontier Province
People's Local Government (Amendment) Act, 1972.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
